title: Finite etale chart and overlap pieces glue to a separated etale base change
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Choose a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup_{a=1}^mU_a$. Then there is a finite partition $X=\coprod_iX_i$ by constructible locally closed affine subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that every $U_a\times_XX_i\to X_i$ and every $(U_a\cap U_b)\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is separated for each $i$. All fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, lines 12045-12060: finite affine cover, common refinement of the separated case for charts and overlaps, affine refinement, and the affine gluing criterion for separatedness

proof.text: Index all overlaps by Fin (m*m), using finProdFinEquiv; diagonal pairs also give the charts. QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact applied to the two affine opens proves compactness of each overlap. Its inclusion into the first affine chart is an open immersion and hence separated; the chart-to-affine-base morphism is affine and separated. Compose these to prove separatedness. Compact source and quasi-separated target give QuasiCompact, while open immersion followed by j is etale. This is written in hcompact and hsep, not assumed as an auxiliary theorem.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'Choose a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup U_j$. Apply the previous case to all the morphisms $U_j\to X$ and $U_j\cap U_{j'}\to X$' (that these morphisms are separated, etale and quasi-compact is left implicit)

proof.text: The proved private helper common_finite_strata inducts on the finite number of morphisms. The empty family uses the singleton identity stratum. In the successor case apply Scheme.exists_etale_separated_stratified_finite to the first morphism, and retain the induction hypothesis for the tail. Convert its LocallyClosedStratification to Scheme.Stratification using the same domains, immersions, strata and range equalities.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'Apply the previous case to all the morphisms $U_j\to X$ and $U_j\cap U_{j'}\to X$' (previous case: More on Morphisms, Lemma 07RZ)

proof.text: In that induction use Scheme.Stratification.inter for the fibre-product common refinement. For the new first morphism, rewrite pullback.condition to express the immersion through the second stratum projection; for the tail it already factors through the first. The proved helper finite_snd_comp uses pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_inv_snd_snd and the finite base-change instance to preserve finiteness along either projection. The intersection stratification supplies constructibility, disjointness and coverage.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'choose a common refinement $X=\coprod X_i$ of the resulting partitions'

proof.text: The proved helper affine_refine_strata applies exists_finite_affine_immersion_constructible_pieces to each immersed stratum. Flatten the finite dependent family of pieces using Fintype.equivFin of the sigma type. Prove disjointness separately for pieces of the same stratum and of different strata; prove coverage by choosing first a containing stratum and then a containing piece. Keep explicit factorization morphisms through the old strata. Apply finite_snd_comp to each factorization to preserve finite overlap morphisms, and recover charts from diagonal overlaps using inf_idem. Etaleness follows directly by composition and base change.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'After refining the partition further we may assume $X_i$ affine as well.'

proof.text: For a final stratum take the inverse images B_a of the original opens under pullback.fst j iota. The proved helper chart_pullback_finite uses pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict, pullbackSymmetry and pullbackRightPullbackFstIso, with projection identities, to identify the structure morphisms of these opens with the chart pullbacks. Preimages preserve the open-cover supremum and intersections. The finite structure morphisms of B_a and B_a cap B_b make both opens affine over the affine stratum.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: 'The morphisms $V_j=U_j\times_XX_i\to X_i$ and $V_{jj'}=(U_j\cap U_{j'})\times_XX_i\to X_i$ are finite etale. Hence $V_j$ and $V_{jj'}$ are affine schemes'

proof.text: In separated_of_finite_charts let e be the overlap inclusion. Its composite with the first chart structure morphism is finite and hence proper. IsProper.of_comp, since that chart morphism is separated, proves e proper. Its image is closed by e.isClosedMap; the open immersion is a preimmersion, so IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion proves it closed. The proved helper closed_overlap_tensor obtains surjectivity of appTop from IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine, and transports it to the restriction map using Scheme.homOfLE_appTop_topIso_inv. Construct the canonical tensor-product ring homomorphism with Algebra.TensorProduct.lift and prove surjectivity using x tensor 1.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, lines 12045-12060: '$V_{jj'}\subset V_j$ is closed as well as open (since $V_{jj'}\to X_i$ is proper, so Morphisms, Lemma 01W6 applies) ... $\mathcal O(V_j)\to\mathcal O(V_{jj'})$ is surjective'

proof.text: Apply separated_of_affine_open_cover to the actual inverse-image cover, its affine charts and overlaps, and the tensor maps just constructed. This proves IsSeparated (pullback.snd j iota) for every final stratum. Combine these facts with the partition and finite-etale data. The theorem signature is unchanged, and no new sorry theorem is used.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 03S9 (etale-cohomology.tex 12035-12061), 01KP (schemes.tex 4157) and the cited nodes. Statement kept. Proof written in 7 steps following the second paragraph of the 03S9 proof: (1) charts U_a and overlaps U_a cap U_b are separated, quasi-compact and etale over the qcqs affine X (left implicit in Stacks); (2) separated case on each; (3) common refinement via the fibre-product construction of lemma-constructible-common-refinement, with constructibility of intersections and finite-etale base change; (4) affine refinement, new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-immersion-affine-constructible-pieces; (5) V_a, V_a cap V_b affine, overlaps identified via lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product, finite implies proper; (6) inclusion of the overlap is proper (proper-over-separated) and an open immersion, hence a closed immersion (01W6 route), giving surjective restriction on global sections; (7) Stacks 01KP(2) over affine base, new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-separated-affine-cover-criterion. The separated-case node lem-weil-pbc-etale-separated-stratified-finite lacks the hypothesis that f be quasi-compact (without it the statement is false: an infinite disjoint union of copies of Y); here it is applied only to quasi-compact morphisms.

reviewed.note: Seven steps along Stacks 03S9 second paragraph: charts and overlaps separated quasi-compact etale over the affine X, the separated case (committed node, hypothesis qc satisfied), common refinement by fibre products of strata, affine refinement (new unsplit node: an immersion with constructible image in an affine scheme splits into finitely many affine constructible pieces), V_a and V_a cap V_b affine and finite over X_i, overlaps closed in charts (proper immersion = closed immersion, leaf of sk-thm-chow; global sections surjective), separatedness by 01KP(2) over an affine base (new unsplit node, a correct specialization). Correct.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_affine_cover_stratification {X U : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U] (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] (m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → U.Opens) (hA : ∀ a : Fin m, IsAffineOpen (A a)) (hcover : ⨆ a : Fin m, A a = ⊤) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ i : Fin n, S i ⟶ X), (∀ i : Fin n, IsAffine (S i) ∧ IsImmersion (ι i) ∧ Topology.IsConstructible (Set.range (ι i))) ∧ Pairwise (fun i k : Fin n ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (ι i)) (Set.range (ι k))) ∧ (⋃ i : Fin n, Set.range (ι i)) = Set.univ ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (a : Fin m), IsFinite (pullback.snd ((A a).ι ≫ j) (ι i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd ((A a).ι ≫ j) (ι i))) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (a b : Fin m), IsFinite (pullback.snd ((A a ⊓ A b).ι ≫ j) (ι i)) ∧ Etale (pullback.snd ((A a ⊓ A b).ι ≫ j) (ι i))) ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, IsSeparated (pullback.snd j (ι i)))
